annotation.authors_or_issuer: INRS (Institut national de recherche et de sécurité)
key_provisions_or_claims: Brochure ED 6540 gives a five-step integration approach: needs analysis, functional design, detailed design, realisation, follow-up.
Cobots pose risks of impact, burns, vibration, musculoskeletal disorders and psychosocial risks.
Technical safeguards include power and force limiting, speed and zone monitoring, fixed or mobile guards.
Organisational measures include training, information, familiarisation and testing.
Integrator and user must maintain continuous dialogue.
annotation.summary_en: INRS news item announcing brochure ED 6540 on integrating collaborative robots in companies. It outlines occupational health and safety risks and a five-step integration approach, with technical safeguards (power and force limiting, zone and speed monitoring) and organisational measures such as training. It also lists related INRS guides.
annotation.title_clean: Robots collaboratifs : une nouvelle brochure de l'INRS pour réussir leur intégration
annotation.title_en: Collaborative robots: a new INRS brochure for successful integration
